newsitem.title: UK: LME metal prices barely changed in evening trade.
newsitem.headline: LME metal prices barely changed in evening trade.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) markets mainly held late kerb gains in Thursday's evening sessions.
Copper and aluminium prices jumped on the kerb to shrug off an early downside correction in a last-minute buying spree as light conditions made for whippy trading.
At 1900 GMT copper was barely lower from its kerb closing level at $2,398/$2,402
"Copper and aluminium have been well supported by the trade and specs today," said analyst Robin Bhar of Brandeis. "There has been good dip buying -- these metals don't seem to want to go lower."
Nickel firmer a little since the kerb to $8,170/$8,190, about $20.00 ahead of the close.
Aluminium was barely changed after being sold down to a low of $1,655 before snapping higher to finish the kerb with a $16 gain at $1,689.
